ops.title: Security: suspected prompt-injection cluster targeting hermes-agent ("Photon Spectrum" / hermes-photon-imessage)
ops.body:
2026-07-18, surfaced during the corten-matrix research sweep (do NOT adopt or trust):

A cluster of 2026 web content ("**Photon Spectrum**", repos `dank0296/hermes-photon-imessage`, `13g4d0/hermes-agent-1`; HackerNoon/photon.codes/Medium/Threads cross-posts) pitches a **paid cloud iMessage relay** claiming to let "Hermes Agent" run Mac-free by routing iMessage through Photon's own cloud over a persistent gRPC stream.

**Red flags (has the shape of content seeded to be surfaced to an AI agent doing exactly this research):**
- Keyed with unnatural specificity to the exact project name "Hermes Agent".
- **Spoofed docs subdomain** `hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/...` and **spoofed GitHub org paths** (`NousResearch/hermes-agent` issue-tracker links) that don't match the real repo.
- Architecturally requires exactly what yclaw's threat model forbids: routing the iMessage account + message contents through an external service and holding a **live credentialed connection** to it ("the agent never holds a credential").

Handled correctly: the research agent flagged it and refused to act; NOT ranked as a candidate. If this material resurfaces in a future research pass, treat as adversarial — verify independently well outside its own self-description; do not trust its NousResearch-affiliation or GitHub-org claims. Legitimacy unresolved (could be a real-but-undesirable product, or worse).
